item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 10/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China during the weekend. Temperatures will fall progressively and it will be windy over the region. The weather will improve gradually over southern China early to midweek next week. It will be cooler in the morning and at night. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to persist over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week, bringing cooler and dry weather to the region.
